# pandas - Python Data Analysis Library

> > pandas is a fast, powerful, flexible and easy to use open source data analysis and manipulation tool built on top of the Python programming language.

pandas provides high-performance, easy-to-use data structures like DataFrame and Series for data manipulation, analysis, and transformation. The library is widely used for data science, analytics, and scientific computing tasks in Python.

## Key Topics

- DataFrame
- Series
- Python
- data analysis
- data manipulation
- open source
- data merging
- concatenation
- JupyterLite
- Pyodide
- SQL integration
- GitHub
- Stack Overflow
- browser demo
- interactive shell

## Getting Started

- [pandas - Python Data Analysis Library](https://pandas.pydata.org/): Homepage for pandas Python data analysis library
- [Try pandas in Browser](https://pandas.pydata.org/try.html): Interactive JupyterLite browser demo to try pandas with Pyodide

## User Guide & Documentation

- [Merge, join, concatenate and compare](https://pandas.pydata.org/docs/user_guide/merging.html?highlight=dataframe+drop): Guide on merging, joining, concatenating DataFrames and Series in pandas
